title: Intracranial EEG Epilepsy - Studies 3, 5 and 6 (Mayo Clinic; IEEG.org)
description: Long-term clinical intracranial EEG recordings from three patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, collected at Mayo Clinic (Rochester, MN) using subdural grid, strip and depth electrodes. The dataset includes expert seizure annotations, channel and electrode metadata, and participant clinical information. It is a BIDS conversion of three IEEG.org/Pennsieve records (Studies 3, 5 and 6), with the original MEF 2.0 samples preserved losslessly in BrainVision format.
methods_description: Recordings were acquired with an XLTek EEG 128 system at 500 Hz with a 0.1 Hz hardware high-pass filter. Original MEF 2.0 files were decoded with mef_lib_2_1 and split into runs at recording discontinuities. They were written as BrainVision INT_32 files and verified sample by sample against the decoded MEF. Seizure annotations from IEEG.org annotations.xml were converted to events using MEF block timestamps.
